summary: Backend smoke + functional testing for PrintForge MVP. All 17 tests executed via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL passed, covering products, external search, auth (seeded session), wishlist, orders (guest + authed with STL upload), designs (with model+preview upload), likes, and file download roundtrip via Emergent Object Storage.
passed: GET /api/products returns 9 seeded products with required fields (product_id, title, price, image_url, category, material, tags)
GET /api/products?category=home returns only home category items (4 items)
GET /api/products/{product_id} returns product; unknown id returns 404
GET /api/search/external?q=dragon returns 6 curated results across Thingiverse/Printables/MyMiniFactory/Cults3D/Thangs with source field
GET /api/auth/me returns user with Bearer <seeded session token>
POST /api/orders as guest with STL file upload succeeds -> object storage put_object works
POST /api/orders as authed user with STL upload succeeds and persists user_id
GET /api/orders returns authed user's orders with storage_path populated
POST /api/wishlist/toggle returns in_wishlist=true; GET /api/wishlist returns product
POST /api/designs with model_file (STL) + preview_image (PNG) succeeds while authed
GET /api/designs returns the newly uploaded public design
POST /api/designs/{id}/like sets liked=true; GET /api/designs/{id} shows likes=1
GET /api/files/download?path=<storage_path> streams file back with byte-identical content (diff match)

notes.auth_method: Seeded user + user_sessions row via mongosh per /app/auth_testing.md; Bearer token used for authed endpoints.
mocked_apis: /api/search/external returns curated static results — real Thingiverse/Printables integrations pending API keys
notes.storage: Emergent Object Storage put/get worked on first attempt; no 403 refresh needed.
